title: frontend / schedule.change_requested (v1) data payload
description: An operator/admin schedule change. Published to the 'frontend.events' exchange with routing key 'schedule.change_requested'; consumed by Booking, which remains the single authority on capacity and applies the change. (ADR-0010.)

requestId.description: Correlates the admin action with Booking's resulting event.

action.description: What the admin wants to do to the schedule.

sessionId.description: Target session. Null when action = create (Booking assigns the id).

plannedStart.description: New planned start (for create/reschedule). RFC3339 UTC.

plannedEnd.description: New planned end (for create/reschedule). RFC3339 UTC.

adminActor.description: The admin account that initiated the change (for audit attribution).

at.description: When the admin issued the change (RFC3339 UTC).
